title: The Drowned Procession
text: Out of the river walk the drowned, in their Sunday clothes, in a slow procession toward the Rift Gate. They knock at every House's door as they pass, asking for the ones they lost.

options.label: Open the door and hear the names they ask for.

outcomes.text: They name an ancestor of the House, long dead, and bow to the hall. The water they leave behind is clean.
They name one of your living, and wait. They go at last, but that Scion has dreamed of deep water every night since.

options.label: Bar the door and wait for dawn.

outcomes.text: Wet handprints dry on the door. They are still there in spring, no matter how it is scrubbed.
The knocking goes on all night. Everyone inside hears their mother's voice in it.
At the Gate they turn and give back what the river took: coins, rings, a sword green with weed.
A Scion walked with them too far, and came back coughing up river silt for a month.
